import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
root = Path('/home/domen/dev/casita3')
out = root / 'benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-collection-paging'
artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / 'benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-statement-cache/candidate-probe-build.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
command = [str(root / '.devenv/profile/bin/rustc'), '--edition=2024', '-O', str(out / 'sql_profile.rs'), '-o', str(out / 'sql-profile')]
for name in ('turso','tokio','tempfile','blake3','serde_json'):
    artifact = next(a for a in artifacts if a.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and a['target']['name'] == name)
    rlib = next(p for p in artifact['filenames'] if p.endswith('.rlib'))
    command += ['--extern', f'{name}={rlib}']
    command += ['-L', f'dependency={Path(rlib).parent}']
for artifact in artifacts:
    for path in artifact.get('linked_paths',[]):
        command += ['-L', path]
(out / 'sql-profile-build-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2)+'\n')
subprocess.run(command, check=True)

compare.py.content:
"""Compare complete collection commits using identical retained probes."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

root = Path('/home/domen/dev/casita3')
out = root / 'benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-collection-paging'
binaries = json.loads((out / 'binaries.json').read_text())
results = []
for repetition in range(1, 4):
    order = ('baseline', 'fixed') if repetition % 2 else ('fixed', 'baseline')
    for variant in order:
        stem = f'{repetition}-{variant}'
        env = {**os.environ, 'CASITA_COLLECTION_COUNTS': '65537', 'CASITA_COLLECTION_ITERATIONS': '1'}
        command = [str(root / '.devenv/profile/bin/time'), '-f', '%U %S %M', '-o', str(out / f'{stem}.usage'),
            binaries[variant]['path'], 'metadata::sqlite::tests::benchmark_statement_cache_collection',
            '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture']
        entry = {'variant': variant, 'repetition': repetition, 'command': command,
            'settings': {'objects': 65537, 'warm_iterations': 1}, 'load_before': os.getloadavg(),
            'started_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()}
        print('START ' + stem, flush=True)
        started = time.monotonic()
        with (out / f'{stem}.log').open('w') as log:
            subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=600)
        output = (out / f'{stem}.log').read_text()
        assert output.count('1 passed') == 1
        samples = [json.loads(line.removeprefix('collection_sample ')) for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('collection_sample ')]
        assert len(samples) == 1 and samples[0]['count'] == 65537 and len(samples[0]['samples']) == 2
        user, system, rss = map(float, (out / f'{stem}.usage').read_text().split())
        entry.update(status='passed', elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started, load_after=os.getloadavg(),
            user_seconds=user, system_seconds=system, max_rss_bytes=int(rss)*1024, sample=samples[0])
        results.append(entry)
        (out / 'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(f"PASSED {stem}: collection ms {[round(x['nanos']/1e6,2) for x in samples[0]['samples']]}", flush=True)

summary = {}
for warm in (False, True):
    values = {v: [next(s['nanos'] / 1e6 for s in r['sample']['samples'] if s['warm'] == warm)
        for r in results if r['variant'] == v] for v in ('baseline', 'fixed')}
    medians = {v: statistics.median(x) for v, x in values.items()}
    paired_changes = [(f/b-1)*100 for b, f in zip(values['baseline'], values['fixed'])]
    summary['warm' if warm else 'first'] = {'values_ms': values, 'medians_ms': medians,
        'paired_changes_percent': paired_changes, 'change_percent': (medians['fixed']/medians['baseline']-1)*100}
(out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), flush=True)
